description: Workflow v3.1 Enterprise. LLM-adapted Scrum sprint: PLANNING→ACTIVE→REVIEW→RETRO→CLOSE. TaskRegistry actions as the sole LLM interface (no direct CPG/CKG/delta-spring exposure). REFINE with context, loop detection, and knowledge capture.

context_bag.description: Catalog of placeholders the engine resolves in prompt templates (prompts/{prompt_id}.prompt.json) before presenting to the agent. Each placeholder is replaced with its current value from sprint state or context_bag on step(). If a placeholder is not found, it is left literal.

project_id.description: Active project ID detected or provided by the user

sprint_goal.description: Active sprint goal, defined during planning

task_count.description: Total number of tasks in the active sprint backlog

completed_count.description: Number of completed tasks in the active sprint

goal_display.source: Engine formats sprint_goal for dashboard: 'Goal: <sprint_goal>' or 'Goal: Not set'
goal_display.description: Formatted sprint goal line for dashboard display

ready_tasks.source: Engine runs DAGBuilder + JobScheduler.get_ready_tasks() from plan.json depends_on
ready_tasks.description: List of tasks whose dependencies are all met and are ready to work on

blocked_tasks.source: Engine runs DAGBuilder + JobScheduler.get_blocked_tasks() from plan.json depends_on
blocked_tasks.description: List of tasks blocked by incomplete dependencies

task_summary.source: Engine formats task summary for review: brief list of completed/pending
task_summary.description: Formatted task status summary for sprint review

source_node.source: Engine injects when transitioning to REFINE
source_node.description: Node that triggered refine: DESIGN, ANALYZE, IMPLEMENT, or VERIFY

attempt.source: Engine reads counter from sprint-state on entering REFINE

error_context.source: Engine injects from the failed action result
error_context.description: Failure context: quality gate, error, message

task_id.source: Engine inyecta desde el sprint-state al hacer transicion a ANALYZE, IMPLEMENT o REFINE
task_id.description: Active task ID (TASK-XXX). Used by agent to fetch briefing via context tasks.

predicates.source: Engine reads task validation.predicates from plan.json
predicates.description: List of validation predicates for the current task (DoD criteria)

sprint_planned.description: After planning, show the sprint dashboard

plan_approved.description: When plan is approved, update sprint progress

task_approved.description: When a task is PO-approved, update sprint progress metrics

qa_failed.description: When QA rejects, auto-route to refinement

implementation_rejected.description: Log implementation rejection reason to CKG

refine_exhausted.description: Notify PO when refine attempts are exhausted

sprint_closed.description: Archive sprint metrics when sprint closes
